title: Laparoscopic Versus Open Mesh Repair of Bilateral Primary Inguinal Hernia
brief_summary: The best approach for simultaneous repair of bilateral inguinal hernia is controversial. The aim of this study is to compare the outcomes after laparoscopic versus open mesh repair of bilateral primary inguinal hernia
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with painless uncomplicated primary bilateral inguinal hernias

Exclusion Criteria:

* Immune compromised patients
* Coagulopathy
* Chronic liver or renal disease
* High-risk patients unfit for major surgery (ASA III or IV),
* Massive scrotal hernias, Recurrent or Complicated hernias
* Groin pain due to any other pathology
* Previous infra-umbilical surgery
